content_sections.heading: MANIT Bhopal JRF Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates should download and read the MANIT Bhopal Jobs 2026 notification PDF carefully to check vacancy details, eligibility, age limit, and application instructions. The notification also includes important dates and selection process details. The direct download link is available in the Important Links section below. content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: First Class M.E./M.Tech/M.Sc in Mechanical Engineering/Production Engineering/Automobile/Material Science/Metallurgy/Physics/Computer Science or equivalent. B.Tech/B.E. or Integrated Professional Degree with min CGPA 7.0/10 and GATE or 6 months experience.

content_sections.heading: Age Limit
content_sections.text: Maximum Age Limit: 32 years Age Relaxation: As per Government of India rules

content_sections.heading: MANIT Bhopal JRF Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for this recruitment is Junior Research Fellow (JRF) or Project Fellow.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the JRF post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode is Walk-in Interview. Candidates need to attend the interview directly.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled for 06 October 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification required for the JRF post?
faq.answer: Candidates need a First Class M.E./M.Tech/M.Sc in relevant fields or a B.Tech/B.E. with GATE or 6 months experience.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for the JRF post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 32 years, with age relaxation as per Government of India rules.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for the JRF position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a stipend of Rs 37,000/- per month plus HRA.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST).

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will be based on a Walk-in Interview.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the walk-in interview scheduled to be held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at Maulana Azad National Institute of Technology Bhopal, Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh, 462003.
